Name: Better Married Shane Mod
Author: Auronlova
Description:
[b][u]UPDATE: Due to the massive coding overhaul in 1.6 this mod no longer works. :( The coding was basic enough before for me to mod and figure out with the little knowledge I have, but has become too complicated for me now. If anyone knows how or wants to update this mod for the newest patches, you have my blessings and permission. 
[/u][/b]

Does this sound familiar? You're super excited to finally marry your bae Shane and then, to your disappointment, there is barely any change in your interactions. I was. Very. So much so I made this mod!

(This IS my first mod so I'm sorry if there are any bugs or errors. I have tested it pretty thoroughly on my files but I don't know if there might be some problems for others.)


------------



[size=4][u]About This Mod:[/u][/size]
This mod aims to make Shane's marriage dialogue less cold and more enjoyable, as well as enhance the interactions you have with him and the other villagers.


[size=4][u]Recommendations:[/u][/size]
If you use this mod it is HIGHLY recommended you use it with [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1003/?]this portrait mod[/url] since my mod uses custom portrait images I edited from the original DCBurger ones. I also highly recommend using it with [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1061/?]Shane Dialogue Overhaul[/url] since my mod's Shane is somewhat based off of this portrayal. If not, I recommend trying out just the [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/872/?]Flirty Villagers Mod[/url] to make things more interesting.


[size=4][u]Installation:[/u][/size]
[size=2]This mod must be installed manually.

First back up your original files, as well as your portraits. The portrait edit I made does override a few of the original pictures used in Shane's non-married dialogue, so it's best to only add my mod AFTER you have married him. In order to install this mod extract the Dialogue folder into your Stardew Valley 'Characters' folder and allow it to override. Do the same with the portraits. Don't forget to save the Shane.png OVER the DCBurger edit!


------------[/size]

[size=4][u][color=#ffff00][center]WARNING!!![/center][/color][/u]
[/size][b]THIS MOD IS NOT PG.[/b] It's more like PG-13. There are not so subtle innuendos and dirty talk so you have been warned. [b]ALSO[/b] I have probably heavily romanticized Shane. I am not trying to sweep away his personality (and I hope that is evident in the dialogue) but I did want to show Shane's improvement with his alcoholism and depression thanks to the player's support. If you have any ideas/suggestions please feel free to let me know.


------------

[size=2][u]Optional[/u]:[/size] If you would like people (and Shane) to comment on your anniversary, I will provide the files I use for that personally. All you simply have to do would be change [i]my[/i] current anniversary date (Spring 20) to whatever date you want within the dialogue files. You can do this by downloading and using [i][b]XNB Node [/b][/i]found [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/modding-guides-and-general-modding-discussion-redux.109131/]here[/url].
